 David suggests installing R on all the cytometer computers.  I would like to avoid doing this and simply take advantage of windows tool to set-up a 'cron job' like task to copy the essentail files from individual workstations to a common site. The windows task scheduler tool seems like the tool to use.  

```{r}
# packages to install

# CRAN packages
install.packages("dplyr")
install.packages("ggplot2")
install.packages("devtools")
install.packages("BiocManager")

#Bioconductor packages
library(BiocManager)
install("flowCore")
install("flowWorkspace")
install("ggcyto")

#Git hub packages
library(devtools)
# Updated call to install Luciernaga based on warning message that install_github was deprecated
pak::pak("https://github.com/DavidRach/Luciernaga", dependencies = TRUE)
```
